notes:
What's new in EnigmaCast

• Faster IPTV films and series: the first posters of a category appear at once, the rest is added while you browse.
• Easier Back button: while watching live TV, Back now first closes the information bar at the bottom. Press Back again to open the TV guide.
• Faster updates: updates now download much faster, and the app is less than half its previous size.
• Smoother picture: EnigmaCast can now switch your TV to the right picture rate for what you're watching, so fast movement like football looks smoother. Turn it on under Settings › Display (Automatic frame rate). It's off by default.
• EnigmaCast on your TV home screen: rows with your favourite channels, IPTV favourites, Continue watching and your recordings. Select a card to start watching straight away. Recordings now show film artwork, and channels show their own logo.
• TV guide for more channels: the channel list and TV guide now show what's on for every satellite channel list, including Italian and other foreign channels. IPTV channels without a guide of their own now borrow it from the same satellite channel.
• Easier channel list setup: choose from 8 ready-made channel lists (including Vhannibal, GioppyGio, Matze, Dona and Predrag) in one simple menu.
• Tidier IPTV settings: each IPTV provider now opens in its own window, so the settings page stays clear.
• Fixes: moving between the channel list and the programme info in IPTV works properly again.
